faqs.text: Green Meadows, Velachery: 2BHK apartments from ₹72 lakhs to ₹85 lakhs.
Green Meadows, Velachery: 3BHK apartments from ₹1.05 crore to ₹1.30 crore.
Site visits are available Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 6 pm. Sunday is closed.
Amenities: swimming pool, gym, children's play area, 24x7 security and power backup.
Home loans are available through partner banks including SBI and HDFC.
Possession of Green Meadows is planned for December 2027.
Palm Heights, Medavakkam: 1BHK apartments from ₹38 lakhs to ₹45 lakhs.
One covered car parking slot is included with every apartment.
Booking amount is ₹2 lakhs, refundable within 15 days of booking.
The project is RERA approved. The RERA registration number is printed on the brochure.
